findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
findings.description: Protects against protocol downgrade attacks, SSL stripping, and cookie hijacking.
findings.evidence: Header not present in HTTP response

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.description: Mitigates Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), code injection, and data exfiltration.
findings.evidence: Header not present in HTTP response

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking Protection)
findings.description: Prevents clickjacking by controlling if the site can be rendered inside a <frame> or <iframe>.
findings.evidence: Header not present in HTTP response
findings.remediation: X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN, or CSP frame-ancestors)

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options (MIME Sniffing)
findings.description: Prevents MIME-type confusion attacks by forcing browsers to honor declared Content-Type.
findings.evidence: Header not present in HTTP response

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Controls how much sensitive referrer information (e.g. tokens in URLs) is sent in requests.
findings.evidence: Header not present in HTTP response

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Restricts browser features and APIs (camera, microphone, geolocation) accessible to the origin.
findings.evidence: Header not present in HTTP response

findings.title: Server Software Version Disclosure
findings.description: Discloses server software and version numbers, aiding targeted vulnerability research.
findings.remediation: Disable detailed banner in web server (e.g., Apache 'ServerTokens Prod', Nginx 'server_tokens off').
